newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska feedlot cattle market not trading - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska feedlot cattle market not trading - private.

text.p: Nebraska's feedlot cattle market was inactive, with bids mostly at $107.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, passed by owners asking $109.00 to $110.00, market sources said.
Last sales were at $109.00 late last week in light volume, although there were a few at $110.00 on Thursday.
On a live basis, packer bids at $66.00 were passed by owners asking $67.00 to $68.00, the sources said.
Shwolist supplies this week were estimated unchanged near 80,000 head, compared with last week, they said.
